title: Terminal composite proton/electron precision law
statement: The admitted proton/electron algebraic graph receives the complete electromagnetic self-coupling of its three-depth colour composite.  Binary-by-colour-cubed support has heavy complement 53; the complete colour bulk and its three carried boundary channels supply support 27+3=30; both charged Fold ends force alpha squared; and the sole terminal return transports the two Fold labels through down-depth five and colour volume 27 once.  The retained ratio is therefore the admitted algebraic ratio times One held by 53 alpha^2/30 times (One plus 2 alpha/135).
generation_rule: Generate the complete eleven-axis product of base graph, composite depth, complement, coupling order, bulk/boundary support, terminal return, transport, orientation, custody, provenance and extension forms.
grammar_boundary: All first terminal electromagnetic dressings of the admitted proton/electron algebraic graph that use each already admitted composite-depth, colour-volume, boundary-channel, Fold-label, cover-depth and terminal-alpha carrier exactly once in its typed role.

exact_result: Let R3 be the admitted exact algebraic proton/electron ratio and alpha the reciprocal of the admitted terminal inverse-alpha.  The unique retained successor is R4 = R3 * [1 - delta] in conventional notation, represented only as positive_take(One,delta), where delta = (53/30) alpha^2 [1 + (2/135) alpha].
induction_base: The admitted proton/electron graph supplies one complete normalized colour-bound carrier.
induction_step: Attach alpha once to each charged Fold end, distribute their joint support over all colour-bulk and carried-boundary cells, then transport the sole terminal return through every down-depth/volume cell; every typed carrier is consumed once and no successor remains.

no semantic numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof value
no conflation of observationally informed derivation with target-readable execution
